maya: heads up — after the tokenizer upgrade (hf-tokenizers 0.12.1 -> 0.13.0) i ran the hf->redwood convert on llama-x and saw BOS/EOS/PAD/UNK ids shift. quick repro below, reproducible on my dev env.

maya: repro steps:
```bash
# convert script we use
python tools/hf_to_redwood.py --model-dir models/llama-x --out redwood/llama-x --preserve-specials false
```

maya: sample output from converter log (trimmed):
```
loading tokenizer... vocab_size=50288
applying added_tokens.json merge (n=42) -> inserting at first_free_index=50240
special tokens remapped: pad=50240 unk=50241 bos=50242 eos=50243
final vocab_size=50288
```

maya: but the model checkpoint expects pad=0, bos=1, eos=2, unk=3. downstream evals show chat templates breaking (padding logic ends up truncating prefixes).

samir: ugh. did hf change how added_tokens are assigned? i thought they always append. can you paste added_tokens.json?

maya: here's the trimmed added_tokens.json we got with the model (note order):
```json
["▁<ip>", "▁<url>", "<|new_token_1|>", "<|new_token_2|>"]
```

maya: converter used a merge strategy that inserts the added tokens into first free slots, not append, because tokenizer.model_max_index was set incorrectly (50288 vs actual 50240) — so there was an overlap that caused special tokens to be allocated into the high indexes instead of reserved low indexes.

jin: i ran a quick diff between tokenizer.json versions. hf v0.13 introduced a normalization tweak PLUS a change in tokenizer.json semantics: they started exposing "num_special_tokens" as optional and some tokenizers set model_max_index=vocab_size by default. if converter assumes num_special_tokens=0 it will calc first_free_index wrongly.

lex: can we patch the converter to detect any of these conditions and force-preserve the special token ids? like read tokenizer.special_tokens_map and write them into redwood metadata before any insert. quick fix: special remap layer in tools/hf_to_redwood.py

samir: suggested mitigation (can run quickly on infra):
```python
# remap special tokens before merging added_tokens
specials = tokenizer.special_tokens_map
for name, tok in specials.items():
    if name == 'pad':
        tokenizer.add_special_tokens({'pad_token': tok})
# ensure pad_token_id stays 0 if model expects it
if tokenizer.pad_token_id != 0:
    tokenizer._convert_id_to_token(0)  # cheap check, then force remap
```

samir: not pretty but should get evals green while we ship a proper converter patch.

ops-bot: deploy queued: converter-hotfix/2141598765 -> staging (CI tests: token-id-preserve, chat-template-e2e).

maya: ran the hotfix locally, re-converted and sanity-checked token ids: pad=0 bos=1 eos=2 unk=3. ran qa evals: leaderboard sim score returned to baseline but still seeing some small regression in long-context prompts (likely caching + kv-index mismatch from the earlier bad convert).

jin: file a short postmortem? also add a guard in onboarding checklist: "verify special_token ids after conversion" and add a unit test that asserts pad_token_id in {0,1,2,3} depending on model family.

maya: will do. adding a small reproducer gist to the model onboarding ticket. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
